name.value: Wild Rose Camping and RV Park

description.value: A family-run campground sitting between the Cascade Mountains and the Fraser River, 7.7 km west of Hope on Hwy 1, with grassy tent sites, free hot showers, flush washrooms open 24/7, and an explicit cross-Canada cyclist welcome; highway-adjacent and open year-round.

address.value: 62030 Flood Hope Road, Hope BC V0X 1L2

raw_osm.name: Wild Rose Camping and RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and rich. The amenities page and about page confirm tenting sites, free hot showers, coin laundry, free WiFi, potable water (full hook-up sites include water; showers/bathrooms confirm on-site water), and ice for sale at the office store. The site explicitly states 'GREAT FOR CYCLISTS – Approved Accommodations for those Biking Across Canada' and features a dedicated 'Cycle Canada' navigation section, confirming cyclist-friendliness. OSM phone, address, and website URL all match the website exactly.
concerns: The 'Cycle Canada' subpage is referenced in the navigation but its content was not included in the fetched website text; it may contain additional cyclist-specific details (e.g., cyclist rates, secure storage) that could not be verified.
Website footer shows '© 2020 by Gore Brothers' suggesting it has not been updated since 2020; amenity details appear current but should be confirmed on next review cycle.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Year-round campground explicitly approved and marketed for cross-Canada cyclists, with tenting sites, free showers, laundry, and a dedicated Cycle Canada page — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free reservations number 1-800-463-7999 appears on the website but is not in OSM tags. Email wildrose@uniserve.com also confirmed on site.
